svg.title: Decaying process rewards mitigates reward hacking
svg.desc: Fixed-weight process rewards rise while outcome reward declines after update 30. Decaying lambda from 0.5 to zero over updates 20 to 30 improves outcome reward. Validation truncation falls from 44.1% to 6.2%. Faint lines connect recorded observations; thick lines are centered five-observation means, matching paper Figure 1(c).
